notes_for_editor: Much of the narrative rests on LighthouseFriends (copyrighted; paraphrased) and the foundation site; pre-1891 Light-House Board reports are not in the corpus so the 1869 appropriation, 1885 bell and 1876 log entries are second-hand via LighthouseFriends. Wanton Chase's years differ between LighthouseFriends (about age seven) and the foundation (1913-1918). Curtis end year 1918 vs 1919. Curtis 1899 distress signal: Providence News says flagstaff head, nelights says flag upside down (not repeated as fact). Grave-robber episode rests only on nelights (blog). Fiscal 1894 report entry on Plymouth is OCR ('Plymotith'); matched the entry by page text. Foundation says 1984 formation; LighthouseFriends says July 1984. Newport Bridge ('Pell') opening 1969 per NRHP. Not checked: Richard Champlin's 'Rose Island Centennial' (Newport History 1970).
